verdict.rationale: Bitbucket documents a built-in CI/CD tool, Bitbucket Pipelines, for creating automated workflows on hosted or private runners, with centralized pipeline status and deployment environments. The evidence never says pipelines are defined as code in the repository, and never names push or pull-request triggers, so only the general CI/CD capability is established. Missing for 10: evidence of pipeline-as-code configuration files in the repo, explicit push and pull-request trigger documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
